metrics.label: 客单价
metrics.description: GMV ÷ 下单用户数（按人计算）。按订单计算的是“笔单价”。

answer.text: 2026年8月，杭州的客单价为 241.95 元（GMV 14,033.38 元，下单用户数 58 人）。

queries.title: 客单价
queries.sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND s.city = '杭州'
LIMIT 1000

  COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS buyer_count,
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 0), 2) AS aov

    channel,
    customer_id,

    gross_amount,
    order_date,

    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,

    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
JOIN (
  SELECT
    city,
    opened_date,
    region_id,
    store_id,
    store_name,
    store_type
  FROM stores
) AS s
  ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
  AND s.city = '杭州'
LIMIT 1000
